study type: Retrospective population-based interrupted time series analysis
exposure: Late preterm singleton deliveries with pregestational diabetes mellitus
Singleton pregnancies with pregestational diabetes mellitus
Dissemination of the Antenatal Late Preterm Steroids trial findings
pregnancies complicated by pregestational diabetes mellitus
Twin pregnancies without pregestational diabetes mellitus
outcome: Incidence rate of immediate assisted ventilation use
Incidence rate of ventilation use for more than 6 hours
cohort: Infants born in the United States between 34 0/7 and 36 6/7 weeks of gestation from August 1, 2014, to April 30, 2018
finding: The dissemination of the Antenatal Late Preterm Steroids trial was associated with a decreased incidence of immediate assisted ventilation use in late preterm twin deliveries, but no change in ventilation use for more than 6 hours; however, there was no decrease in neonatal respiratory outcomes among singleton deliveries with pregestational diabetes mellitus.
